summary: REPLACE: 2-4 sentences about who you are professionally. Be broad here - the tailoring script will narrow this down per job, so give it plenty to work with.

experience.title: REPLACE: Job title or role (include class projects / internships if no formal jobs yet)
achievements: REPLACE: One accomplishment per line. Use action verb + what you did + measurable result if possible. e.g. 'Built a Flask API that reduced manual data entry time by 30%'
REPLACE: Add as many as apply - the tailoring script will pick the most relevant ones per job, so more raw material is better

projects.name: REPLACE: Project name (this is where your 'minor projects done here' go)
projects.description: REPLACE: What it does and why you built it
achievements: REPLACE: What you specifically did/built, same style as experience achievements
projects.link: REPLACE: optional URL (GitHub repo, live demo, etc.)
